#{id}
order by field(p.rank_id,
#{id} )) as a
left join rank_song as b on b.rank_id=a.rank_id left join user as u on u.user_id=a.user_id left join song as s on s.song_id=b.song_id left join singer as si on si.singer_id=s.singer_id order by b.ranking asc
select count(*) from vote_record where rank_id=#{rankId} group by rank_id;
select count(*) from love_record where rank_id=#{rankId} group by rank_id;

select distinct c.com_id,c.rank_id,c.user_id,c.parent_id,u.username,pu.username as parent_username, c.comment_content,c.comment_time,ifnull(cl.like_count,0) as like_count, case when cl2.user_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_liked from comment as c left join (select com_id,count(*) as like_count from like_comment group by com_id ) as cl on c.com_id=cl.com_id left join like_comment as cl2 on cl2.com_id=c.com_id and cl2.user_id=#{userId} left join user as u on c.user_id = u.user_id left join personal_rank p on p.rank_id=c.rank_id left join comment pc on pc.parent_id=c.com_id left join user pu on pu.user_id=pc.user_id where c.rank_id=#{rankId} and c.id_delete=0 order by c.comment_time desc limit 50
